subject: [PATCH RFC v4 0/12] mm: use per-VMA lock in __access_remote_vm for improved monitoring reliability

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Introduced a per-VMA lock to reduce contention on the mmap lock and improve monitoring reliability. Also made improvements to get_user_page_vma() and added untagged_addr_remote_unlocked() for RISC-V.

2026-07-24.patch_summary: The patch series aims to improve the reliability of monitoring in Linux by introducing a per-VMA lock in __access_remote_vm. This change is intended to reduce contention on the mmap lock, which can lead to stalls in large multi-threaded workloads. The patches also include improvements to the get_user_page_vma() function and the addition of untagged_addr_remote_unlocked() for RISC-V architectures.
